verdicts.why: The PPM truck-mounted mobile crane is one of the heavy machinery scrap items shown in the advert.
The advert and photos specify a V6 3.6 engine, while the model answered a V8 engine.
Bundled insulated scrap cable is the same kind of aluminium electrical cable shown in the photos.
A bundle of used self-help and motivational books matches the advertised motivational books.
A car headlight assembly is the same item as the advertised Honda Accord headlamp.
A used Toyota/Lexus engine matches the advertised NX200 engine without contradicting the title.
The photos show a gearbox/transmission mount, but the model identified an engine/motor mount bracket.
